summary: Build practical DPO skills in DPIA, RoPA, breach response, and privacy governance. Train with templates and real-world exercises.
lede: Data protection officer training gives privacy, compliance, legal, and information security professionals a practical approach to governing personal-data processing. Participants learn to map data and maintain processing records, assess privacy risks through DPIAs, and design controls for retention, access, consent, and data minimization. They also work on data-subject request and breach-response workflows, vendor and AI privacy oversight, and dashboards that communicate risks and corrective actions to leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage privacy obligations, support governance decisions, or translate regulatory requirements into practical controls.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of data protection concepts, organizational governance, and basic compliance processes. Prior exposure to privacy notices, breach handling, records management, or information security controls will help you move faster, but no coding is required. Advanced topics such as AI-related privacy risk and privacy-enhancing technologies are taught at operational application level, not engineering level. You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises and be prepared to review sample policies, processing records, and case scenarios.
